description: This file defines types and functions related to bundled plugin build entries, including type definitions for build entry objects and parameter objects, as well as functions to collect, list, and retrieve dependencies and artifacts related to plugins.

methods.name: export function collectBundledPluginBuildEntries( collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects and returns an array of bundled plugin build entries based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a record (mapping) of build entry identifiers to string values based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists the pack artifacts related to bundled plugins based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists the runtime dependencies for bundled plugins based on optional parameters.
